_description: Corrected enrichment examples for enrich_items.py. Loaded at --prepare time and injected into enrichment_input.json as a feedback_context block so Claude can learn from past corrections without re-enriching already-done items.
_inject_instructions: When you see an object with _type=feedback_context in enrichment_input.json, read these examples before enriching the items. Apply the same patterns, groupings, and naming conventions shown here.

examples._note: ADD CORRECTED EXAMPLES HERE AS THE PROJECT PROGRESSES

_format.lesson: the generalised rule to apply to future similar items

grouping_rules.detail: FG (friction grip), RA (right angle / slow-speed), and HP (handpiece / straight) burs are ALWAYS separate Shopify products even if they are the same shape and grit. Shank type determines the handpiece — a dentist ordering FG burs cannot use RA burs.
Even if two burs look identical, if one is Komet and one is Diatech they must be separate Shopify products. Brand provenance matters for ordering and quality assurance.

grouping_rules.rule: Generic / unknown vendor items cannot be grouped
grouping_rules.detail: If the brand field is blank or 'Generic', treat as unknown manufacturer. Do not group with any named brand. Give it a standalone Shopify product.

variant_naming_rules.rule: Use clinical option names, never Option 1 / Option 2 / Config
Avoid ' / ' in option names — Shopify rejects it
